note: Bowman County (ND) has a 2012 zoning ordinance; its district map is kept as a paper map in the County Auditor's office, and the county planning page says a zoning map update is in progress. The City of Bowman publishes its zoning map only as a static PDF (Figure_11 Existing Zoning). No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning polygon layer was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches, the county's OffRoad Software map viewer (bowman.offroadsoftware.com) exposes no discoverable zoning service, and the Brosz-built City of Bowman online zoning app has no public service URL. Contact: Bowman County Planning & Zoning (701) 523-3129, tax.zoning@bowmancountynd.gov.
